anomalies.observed: The fan connector's supply pin J4.2 carries the net VCC_OUT, which is wired only to the VCC_STABLE jumper terminal JP2.1 and to nothing else. The high-side PMOS Q2's three pins land on NET0001, VCC and Q_PMOS_GSD; none of them is VCC_OUT. The switched output node (NET0001, also on R4/Q2 pin1) is instead tied to J4.3, and J4.4 (NET0012) is a single-pin net with no other connection.
anomalies.expected: In a high-side fan driver the PMOS drain must feed the fan's power pin (J4.2, net VCC_OUT) so the MCU can switch the fan on/off; the specification describes this board as 'an ATtiny-driven fan controller', so the fan must be drivable from the MCU via the PMOS.
anomalies.impact: The fan's supply pin is never connected to the PMOS output (it is left floating or, with the jumper closed, tied to the gate node), so the fan receives no switched power and cannot be controlled; the board's primary function fails.
